fullDescription: Create a fixed 1600×900 scientific presentation graphic for a PhD qualifying-exam PowerPoint. All text must be editable HTML; use restrained CSS or inline SVG scientific icons. No photos, raster images, webpage UI, browser chrome, cartoon style, or tiny text. Match Aims 1–2 with off-white, deep navy, teal, coral, gold, 70 px margins, body text at least 21 px. Title exactly: “Aim 3 · Test in vivo efficacy and safety in chemoresistant PDAC”. Subtitle exactly: “Optimize tumor delivery and dosing → establish tolerability → demonstrate chemosensitization”. Create a connected two-row pathway of five task cards over left 73%, a right “IN-VIVO SUCCESS GATE”, and bottom outcome band. 3A “Resistant xenograft”: athymic nude mouse with flank tumor; “GEM/PTX-resistant BxPC-3”; “Randomize at 100–200 mm³”. 3B “Biodistribution”: targeted versus nontargeted Cy5-siRNA LNPs; “6:1 vs 12:1 lipid:siRNA”; IVIS timeline “1, 6, 24, 48, 72 h”; “Tumor AUC₀–₇₂ h + ex vivo fluorescence”. 3C “Dose & interval”: “0.5 or 1 mg siRNA/kg”; “24–96 h + day 7”; badge “Lowest dose with ≥70% protein knockdown within 48 h”. 3D “Repeat-dose tolerability”: “No treatment-related mortality”; “No humane endpoint / ≥20% body-weight loss”; “CBC · chemistry · organ histology”. 3E “Therapeutic efficacy”: “Targeted target-siRNA LNP + GEM/nab-paclitaxel”; chips “Tumor growth & weight”, “Ki-67 ↓”, “Cleaved caspase-3 ↑”, “TUNEL ↑”. Right gate sections: Delivery—“Greater tumor AUC₀–₇₂ h and ex vivo fluorescence vs matched nontargeted LNP”; Safety—“Acceptable systemic tolerability”; Efficacy—“Significantly lower tumor growth and weight vs chemotherapy alone and prespecified LNP controls”. Bottom exactly: “In-vivo proof that targeted m⁶A suppression restores GEM/nab-paclitaxel sensitivity”. Upper-right eyebrow: “PDAC CHEMORESISTANCE · QUALIFYING EXAM”.
